title: PMSM Current Controller with Pre-Control
text: Discrete-time permanent magnet synchronous machine current controller with pre-control, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Axis prioritization} sets Axis prioritization for voltage limiter; {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d-axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d-axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d-axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q-axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q-axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q-axis anti-windup gain, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero-cancellation, {Enable pre-control voltage} sets the pre-control voltage, {D-axis current vector, id (A)} sets the d-axis current breakpoint vector, {Q-axis current vector, iq (A)} sets the q-axis current breakpoint vector, {Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 *, {Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 * and {Permanent magnet flux linkage matrix, PM(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the flux linkage lookup data 0.04 * ones. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Block sample time -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: Axis prioritization for voltage limiter q-axis (default) | d-axis | d-q equivalence

params.name: D-axis current vector, id (A)
params.values: D-axis current breakpoint vector [-200,0,200] A (default) | monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Q-axis current vector, iq (A)
params.values: Q-axis current breakpoint vector [-200,0,200] A (default) | monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)
params.values: D-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 * ones(3, 3) H (default) | positive matrix

params.name: Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)
params.values: Q-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 * ones(3, 3) H (default) | positive matrix

params.name: Permanent magnet flux linkage matrix, PM(id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: Flux linkage lookup data 0.04 * ones(3, 3) Wb (default) | real matrix
